title: Customer Roadmap Negotiation Playbook and Entropy Budget
creator: Marco Nguyen
description: Create a repeatable playbook that guides how product negotiates, consolidates, and commits to feature asks from high-value customers. Introduces an 'entropy budget' concept to quantify schedule risk from ad-hoc escalations and to make trade-offs explicit during roadmap planning. Deliverables: negotiation script, commitment matrix, entropy budget calculator, escalation SLAs, and a handoff checklist for PM -> Eng/SE -> Success.
comments: 2026-02-25 Marco Nguyen: Initial spike complete. Researched current intake flows used by Sales and CS; found inconsistency in ask formats and missing cost/benefit signal in ~40% of enterprise requests.
2026-03-02 Lena Ortiz: Consolidated 12 recent account asks into canonical template. Prototype entropy budget as simple weighted score (impact * confidence / effort).
2026-03-05 Aisha Patel (Sales lead): Reviewed template. Requested column for contractual commitment type (SLA vs. roadmap mention). Recommended adding renewal timing as a factor.

2026-03-08 Eng sync (Ravi and Priya): Flagged two major trade-offs - committing to UI work with broad downstream infra changes, and a small API tweak that would block Dedicated rollouts. Suggested adding 'technical blast radius' multiplier to entropy formula.

2026-03-12 Lena Ortiz: Draft playbook moved to 'In Review'. Posted draft to Confluence and requested feedback from GTM, Reliability, and Legal. Next: run tabletop negotiation exercise with 3 account owners during Cycle planning week.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical intake template adopted by Sales, CS, and Solutions Engineering (template link available in attachments)
Entropy budget spreadsheet that can be applied to a quarter's candidate asks and outputs a ranked list with a clear commit recommendation
Negotiation playbook (scripts + fallback policies) reviewed and approved by Sales leadership and Head of Customer Success
Commitment matrix that maps request category -> recommended response (Immeadiate commit / Time-boxed evaluation / Backlog / Decline) with example SLAs
Tabletop exercise completed with at least 3 top accounts and retrospective capturing improvements
decision_log: 2026-03-03: Use weighted score (impact * business_urgency * renewal_multiplier) / (effort_estimate * technical_blast_radius) for entropy budget. Rationale: balances revenue urgency with delivery risk.
2026-03-09: Include contractual commitment type as first-class field. Rationale: legal/contractual asks require different handling than feature requests.
2026-03-11: Default response window for high-entropy asks set to '60 days evaluation' unless revenue > $1M ARR, in which case PM propose expedited commit.
rollout_plan: Week 1: Align GTM and Legal on template. Week 2: Run tabletop with 3 accounts and collect feedback. Week 3: Finalize entropy calculator and commit matrix. Week 4: Publish playbook, update roadmap intake SOP, and ship training session for Sales and CS.
